name: Stephen T. Hamilton

summary.text: James Treibert, Hamilton's running mate, holds a 2006 graduate degree from the University of Maryland and is also an independent candidate for President of the United States in the 2028 election, according to Ballotpedia.
Stephen T. Hamilton is the American Constitution Party candidate for Colorado governor; no campaign website or prior political offices were found as of this research.

positions.quote: support President Donald J Trump with tariffs how the nation ran 150 some years and was superior
positions.note: His survey response covers many topics; most of it does not map onto the 25 statements, so only a few positions are coded.

positions.quote: no more unsecure ballot box drop offs , and when it comes to our elections we need to go back to the founding father's policies
positions.note: Calls for ending ballot drop boxes as part of a broader call to change the state's election process.

research_notes: No campaign website, prior offices, or 2026-specific news coverage could be found for Hamilton; he did not answer any question on his iVoterGuide questionnaire. The only substantive material located is a rambling 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response (note: Ballotpedia lists it as his 2024 submission, though he is the certified 2026 governor candidate); most of its content does not state a clear, codeable position on any of the 25 statements, so this profile is thin by necessity rather than by shortcut. A reviewer should double-check whether a more recent statement from him exists before publication.
